Okay, quick update on the move. The movers are coming Thursday morning between eight and ten, so I need everything boxed up by Wednesday night. I already packed the kitchen and most of the books, but the closet is still a mess. My neighbors said they're having a garage sail this weekend, so I might sell the old couch and the extra chairs there instead of hauling them across town. Also, the landlord finally got back to me about the deposit. He said we'll get most of it back as long as we patch the holes in the living room wall. I think we can do that ourselves with a little spackle and some paint. Let me know if you can come over and help on Wednesday.

So I finally finished planning the camping trip for next month. We're going to the state park up north, the one with the big lake and the hiking trails. I reserved two campsites next to each other so everyone has enough room for their tents. My brother is bringing his truck, so he can carry the cooler, the firewood, and the camp stove. I still need to figure out the food, though. I was thinking hot dogs and burgers the first night and maybe chili the second night. Has anyone checked the weather yet? Last time it rained the whole weekend and we were miserable. Also, my friend Jordan wants to bring his dog. I don't think the park allows dogs on the beach, but they're fine at the campsite. Can somebody bring an extra tarp, just in case. I'd really appreciate it, and I can pay you back.
